subject: executor: fix the fail of triggering topn fallback action (#56187)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent, focusing on executor OOM spill/fallback behavior (TopN/Sort/Agg). The change fixes a clear no-op bug in `topNSpillAction.Action()` (previously calling `GetFallback()` without invoking it) by introducing `memory.BaseOOMAction.TriggerFallBackAction()` and using it from spill actions, plus adding a regression test to assert the root exceed action is triggered. No plausible Blocker/High correctness, concurrency, or session/transaction semantic issues found in the touched executor paths.
